decision.reason: Available small draft/MTP models are Qwen3.5-family tokenizer artifacts, not tokenizer-compatible DeepSeek4 drafts for exact target verification. No-draft ngram speculative routes were already rejected by progress/performance evidence.

next_allowed_actions: Continue searching only for tokenizer-compatible DeepSeek4/joyai-llm draft or verifier artifacts, or for compact target representations that pass the existing size/correctness gates.
Do not run speculative token-rate benchmarks until tokenizer/vocab compatibility and target verification semantics are proven.
If no such artifact exists, the remaining route still requires disk cleanup for compact target correctness gates or a new dataflow/interface hard-bound.
